primary_secondary.note: Both: vendor CEO's own analysis and guidance (three delivery modes, expectations for metrics), drawing on customer experience; Gartner report only as hook.

dora_applied.note: DORA named as a basis of the Swarmia platform and 'a starting point, not a destination'; no measurement or how-to guidance.

remote_covid.note: Neither mentions remote work or COVID-19.

data_window.note: Not stated by either (opinion post, no dataset).

cat_productivity.note: Value throughput (stories and epics reaching customers) proposed as the key AI-impact measure; widening productivity spread between engineers.

cat_quality.note: Maintenance load and CI costs discussed as cost/maintenance concerns, not as quality metrics.

cat_satisfaction.note: Developer experience surveys only named once as a basis of the platform.

cat_activity.note: Lines of code and PR count mentioned only as insufficient.

cat_delivery.note: Thin basis: end-to-end flow 'how fast value moves through the system' (customer wait time in bug-report example); NotebookLM also lists DORA delivery metrics, which the text does not itemize.

cat_agile.note: Sprint velocity only mentioned as a breaking old pattern; roadmap/campfire/stream are delivery modes, not metrics.

cat_survey.note: Developer experience surveys only named once, not used or discussed.
